jobs.title: Principal Planning Policy Officer
jobs.description:
Vacancies

Principal Planning Policy Officer

About The Role

We are seeking a motivated and forward-thinking Planning Policy Officer to join our dynamic Planning Policy Team. In this role, you will play a key part in delivering the team’s objectives and enhancing the quality of planning services across the district.

You will actively engage with the local community and embrace new technologies to ensure our services are modern, responsive, and efficient.

What will you be doing?

Your contribution will be vital in supporting the Team Leader and Head of Service in the preparation and review of Local Development Documents, including the Local Plan and its associated components such as the evidence base, community engagement activities, consultation documents, Sustainability Appraisals, Authorities Monitoring Reports, and neighbourhood plans.

You will also take the lead in developing planning policies and proposals, working closely with other council services, partner authorities, and agencies to ensure effective implementation.

The role involves providing planning policy advice at both formal and informal Council meetings and contributing to the overall delivery of a high-quality, value-for-money service. You will help manage the day-to-day operations of the Planning Policy team while adhering to both policy and operational guidelines.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone looking to make a meaningful impact in shaping local development through collaborative, proactive, and community-focused planning work.

About You

To be successful in this role, you must be a Member of the Royal Town Planning Institute (RTPI) and hold a planning-related degree or diploma that is recognised by the RTPI.

This is an excellent opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to local planning in a supportive, collaborative environment.

Our benefits

You can also see our full list of employee benefits on our careers site here: Why you should work for us | West Northamptonshire Council.

About Us

At West Northants Council, it’s about our people. People who thrive with ambition, bubble with new ideas, demand better ways of working, caring about every detail, and who never shy away from a challenge. Our culture is a gateway for new experiences. A place to forge new opportunities. To empower you in your career and unite you with like-minded people.

Our vision is ‘to make West Northants a great place to live, work, visit and thrive’. We truly stand by this and work hard every day to make this a reality. Our corporate values, THRIVE, stand for: Trust, High Performance, Respect, Innovate and Empower, they underpin everything we do and how we deliver services.

We are committed to ensuring diversity, equality, equity, and inclusion is woven into the fabric of WNC and everything we do, to enable all colleagues to develop and maximize their full potential.  We are a disability confident employer, a member of the Armed Forces Covenant, and a Care Leaver Covenant partner

The following film was created by us to communicate our intentions - watch WNC colleagues explain what DEI means to us
.

If you need additional support or reasonable adjustments during the application process, including needing the job description in another format or language, please email careers@westnorthants.gov.uk for support.

Please note
we reserve the right to close the advert early if we receive a high volume of suitable applications, so we recommend applying as soon as possible to avoid disappointment.

West Northants Council, where careers thrive.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (Engineering Intelligence Platform)
jobs.description:
Job overview

As a member of our Customer Success team, you'll own a high-volume portfolio of customers and help them adopt Swarmia into their daily work. This is a scaled role: you'll be responsible for around 180 customers representing roughly $1.3M in ARR, a blend of self-serve SMB and mid-market companies spread across Europe and the US.

Swarmia is designed to be flexible and opinionated, while still adapting to how different engineering teams work. You'll become a product and domain expert in engineering analytics and developer productivity, helping customers make better decisions about how they build software and run engineering teams.

This is a hybrid role based at our Helsinki HQ or remote role in Dublin
. Because part of your portfolio sits in the US, some flexibility in your working hours helps. You'll report to the Head of Customer Success, based out of Dublin.

About us

Swarmia is a fast-growing B2B SaaS company that helps some of the best software companies in the world, including Miro, Lovable, and Bolt, measure and systematically improve developer productivity and experience. We’ve built an international team of talented people who work from our HQ in Helsinki as well as remotely from the US.

In this role you will:

Own and manage a large portfolio of self-serve SMB and mid-market customers across Europe and the US
Lead onboarding and adoption so customers reach value quickly
Design high-value, repeatable touchpoints for busy customers: onboarding cohorts, office hours, webinars, in-app guides, templates, and documentation that scale beyond your calendar
Use in-app usage signals to reach the right customer at the right moment in their adoption journey
Build and automate your own workflows with AI so a portfolio this size stays manageable, and share what works with the rest of the team
Proactively monitor customer health and address risks before they escalate
Run proactive outbound to self-serve customers who have never spoken to us, and turn that first contact into real adoption
Identify expansion opportunities and partner with Sales when accounts grow
Manage renewals across your book of business
Collect and synthesize customer feedback to influence product decisions

You should apply if:

You have at least two years of customer-facing experience in B2B SaaS, supporting the onboarding and adoption of a technically complex product. Time spent in customer support, account management, onboarding, solutions, or program management counts.
You're comfortable being measured on adoption and retention across a large portfolio
You get energy from building things that outlive a single conversation: documentation, templates, webinars, in-app guidance, automations.
You already use AI tools in your own work and are curious how far you can push them.
You enjoy building relationships with engineering and product leaders
You're comfortable getting into the details with customers, including data nuances, metric definitions, and workflow changes.
You have experience working closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering to support customer outcomes.

You should not apply if

You tend to thrive with a focused book of larger customers. This role is deliberately one-to-many, and most of your impact will come from programmes and automation rather than individual relationships.
You're looking for a role with infrequent and highly structured customer touchpoints.
You expect renewals and upsells to be the main focus of the role, while not focusing on adoption, engagement, and helping the customer achieve their business goals.
You'd rather run an established playbook than write one. Much of how we serve this segment does not exist yet.
You're uncomfortable getting into the details with customers, including data nuances, metrics definitions, or workflow changes.
You'd prefer not to speak up when a process has gone stale. At this volume, quietly absorbing broken workflows is how the job becomes unsustainable.

Interview process

Our interview process is thoughtful and thorough. We want to make sure that every person who joins Swarmia is set up for success, and that you have enough information to decide whether Swarmia is the right place for you. The process for this role is as follows:

Intro call with recruiting
- 45 minutes
Hiring manager interview
- 45 minutes
Role play customer demo interview
- 45 minutes
Final panel interview with CEO and Head of Customer Success
- 45 minutes

Why you should join

The product:
You’ll get to work on a domain that’s relevant and interesting to software engineers. Unlike many other tools in this space, Swarmia is not a tool for stack ranking individual engineers or just a dashboard for the leadership — instead, we serve useful insights and tools for the whole engineering organization. As an engineer, this means you deeply understand the problem space.

The developer experience:
Since our product is about sensible software development, we take our own practices seriously. We’re deliberate about how we work, but processes aren’t heavier than they need to be. As one of our engineers described it after his first few weeks at Swarmia: “It feels like a bunch of adults came together and spent some serious time to figure out how to do this software thing well.”

The people:
You’ll get very experienced colleagues with wide skillsets and different backgrounds. We pride ourselves in hiring and retaining smart, kind, and helpful people who are guaranteed to both teach you something and learn something from you.

The communication:
The psychological safety here is real — people voice their concerns without fear, and we’re fast to try new things and scrap them if they don’t work. We’re deeply invested in the product and can have disagreements, but when we do, it’s always in a professional and empathetic manner. Low hierarchy in practice. No blame culture.

The transparency:
We believe in total transparency across departments and leadership. You’ll get full access to all business metrics, leadership team meeting notes, and board meeting memos. We all contribute to this by having our conversations on public Slack channels, openly sharing meeting notes, and collaborating on request for comments (RFC) docs before implementing any bigger changes.

The balance:
We’re a startup with the maturity of a more established company. Things just work, but your initiative matters a lot. We maintain a great work-life balance, don’t do any crunching, and keep up a sustainable pace without compromising quality.

Benefits

Competitive compensation model plus meaningful equity.
Paid annual vacation with 10 extra days for new employees.
Flexible remote/office balance
Great work-life balance — we’re a startup, but we don’t work at an unsustainable pace (many of us have kids and other responsibilities beyond work).

Swarmia provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We’re committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

jobs.title: Expansion Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)  Frankreich C2 FR/DE
jobs.description:
Pflegia ist eine digitale Plattform zur Vermittlung von Pflegekräften.

Unsere Mission: Pflegeeinrichtungen und qualifizierte Fachkräfte schnell, fair und passgenau zusammenzubringen – mit digitalen Lösungen, die wirklich funktionieren.

Wir sind ein wachsendes Unternehmen mit Hauptsitz in Berlin, das auf Eigenverantwortung, transparente Kommunikation und partnerschaftliches Arbeiten setzt. Für das nächste Kapitel unserer Erfolgsgeschichte schlagen wir eine Brücke nach Westeuropa: Von unserem Headquarter in Berlin aus starten wir die Expansion in den französischen Markt.
Dafür suchen wir empathische und umsetzungsstarke Talente im Customer Success, die den Beziehungsaufbau zu französischen Pflegekräften von Tag 1 an mitgestalten.

Aufgaben

Erstkontakt & Betreuung der ersten französischen Pflegehelden! – Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für französischsprachige Pflegekräfte, begleitest sie empathisch ab der ersten Kontaktaufnahme und führst sie erfolgreich durch den Vermittlungsprozess.
Prozessaufbau & Kandidaten-Betreuung im Zielmarkt! – Du nimmst die Wünsche der Pflegekräfte auf Französisch auf, gestaltest ihren Bewerbungsprozess unkompliziert und hilfst dabei, Candidate-Experience-Standards für den französischen Markt neu zu etablieren.
Passgenaue Stellenvermittlung für Frankreich! – Du bringst französische Talente und die ersten Partnerunternehmen zusammen, indem Du Qualifikationen und Wünsche präzise mit den Angeboten der Arbeitgeber matchst.
Feedbackschleifen für den Markteintritt nutzen! – Du sammelst aktiv Rückmeldungen von Kandidaten im neuen Markt, erkennst kulturelle oder prozessuale Besonderheiten und hilfst so, unser Angebot stetig an Frankreich anzupassen.
Enger Schulterschluss mit dem Berliner Sales-Team – Gemeinsam mit dem Key Account Management entwickelst Du maßgeschneiderte Lösungen, um die Erwartungen der ersten französischen Kandidaten und Partnerunternehmen zu übertreffen.
Präzise Dokumentation & Datenpflege – Du pflegst alle Kandidatendaten auf Französisch in unseren Systemen ein und stellst sicher, dass die Kennzahlen für unsere Expansion jederzeit verlässlich sind.
Pionierarbeit im Candidate Success – Du schaffst von Berlin aus echte Win-Win-Situationen im neuen Zielmarkt und gestaltest die internationale Ausrichtung von Pflegia aktiv mit.

Qualifikation

C2-Sprachniveau in Französisch und Deutsch: Nachgewiesen durch Deinen Lebenslauf oder Zertifikate. Du betreust Kandidaten und Ansprechpartner auf Französisch und arbeitest eng mit dem Berliner Team auf Deutsch zusammen – absolute Sprach- und Verhandlungssicherheit auf beiden Sprachen ist zwingend.
Pioniergeist & Aufbaumentalität: Du hast Freude daran, Abläufe im Kundenservice für einen neuen Markt mitzugestalten und flexibel auf die Dynamik einer frühen Expansionsphase zu reagieren.
Kommunikationsstärke und Empathie – Du kannst komplexe Themen im Pflegebereich auf Französisch und Deutsch verständlich erklären und gehst stets wertschätzend auf Menschen zu.
Organisationsgeschick – Du behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Anfragen aus dem neuen Markt den Überblick und arbeitest hochstrukturiert.
Eigeninitiative und Lösungsorientierung – Du packst Hürden im Markteintritt proaktiv an und entwickelst pragmatische Lösungen für kandidatenseitige Herausforderungen.
Digitale Affinität – Du fühlst Dich im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, Slack und Zoom wohl und arbeitest gerne datenbasiert.

Benefits

Top ausgestattetes Office in Berlin – Ein modernes Büro mit zentraler Lage, erstklassiger Anbindung und inspirierender Arbeitsumgebung.
Attraktive Vergütung – Ein faires Grundgehalt plus ungedeckelte Provision, die Deinen Erfolg direkt belohnt.
Einfluss & Wachstum – Du bist maßgeblich an unserem Eintritt in den französischen Markt beteiligt und gestaltest diesen Meilenstein aktiv mit.
Unbegrenzte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten – Zeig, was in Dir steckt! Bei uns gibt es keine Limitationen – ob Du Dich fachlich weiterentwickeln, mehr Verantwortung übernehmen oder eine Führungsposition anstreben möchtest: Deine Karriere ist das, was Du daraus machst! Wir wachsen schnell und bieten Dir die Möglichkeit, gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen.
Moderne Arbeitsausstattung – Laptop, Bildschirm und Headset stehen Dir für ein produktives Arbeiten zur Verfügung.
Effiziente Tools und Systeme – Nutze Slack, Zoom und unser maßgeschneidertes CRM-System, um Deinen Arbeitsalltag effizient zu gestalten.
Regelmäßige Team- und Networking-Events – Von After-Work-Sessions über Fußball oder Volleyball bis zu Teambuilding-Aktivitäten und Firmenläufen.
Kostenlose Verpflegung – Frischer Kaffee, kühle Getränke, Snacks und Obst stehen Dir jederzeit zur Verfügung.
Personalisierte Snack-Bestellungen – Über unsere wöchentliche REWE-Bestellung kannst Du Deine Lieblingssnacks direkt ins Büro liefern lassen.
Friyay-Feeling – Jeden Freitag lassen wir die Woche gemeinsam mit Pizza und Bier im Büro ausklingen.
Haustierfreundliches Büro – Dein Hund ist bei uns herzlich willkommen.
27 Urlaubstage pro Jahr – Für ausreichend Erholung und eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance.

Werde Wegbereiter unseres nächsten großen Kapitels!

Bring Deinen Drive ein, baue echten Social Impact auf und gestalte unseren Markteintritt in Frankreich von Berlin aus aktiv mit.

jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities:

Lead end-to-end Customer Service operations, covering service quality, KPIs, workforce, incident management, and cross-functional coordination.
Drive and optimize Customer Service operations for the U.S. market, enhancing customer satisfaction in alignment with the Global Customer Service strategy.
Develop and execute Customer Service strategies and operational plans aligned with Company objectives.
Develop and implement training programs to build skills and expertise for new and existing employees.
Establish and implement effective Customer Service quality monitoring measures.
Coach employees based on quality assessments, ticket handling results and QA reports.
Coordinate cross-functionally to resolve issues, monitor progress and ensure employee and relevant department compliance with SLAs.
Provide accurate, timely and detailed reports on emerging issues, key customer/driver feedback, and ad-hoc topics or management requests.
Deliver periodic reports with detailed operational performance metrics.
Support the setup and launch of Customer Service operations for the US market.
Contribute to developing IT systems and tools supporting Customer Service operations.
Propose solutions to improve workforce productivity and optimize personnel costs.
Monitor and assess Customer Service quality and performance.
Own overall KPIs and work quality for the assigned team.
Escalate issues affecting customer satisfaction to US Market and Global Leadership, with actionable recommendations.
Evaluate employee performance and recommend rewards, disciplinary actions, or internal transfers.
Oversee and coordinate specialized Customer Service systems, working closely with the Philippines Hub to ensure operational efficiency.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree or higher
At least 1 year in a similar Customer Service/Contact Center role using advanced Contact Center and CRM systems.
At least 1 year in Contact Center, Customer Support, or Operations, preferably in ride-hailing platforms.
Strong knowledge and hands-on proficiency in Customer Service technology systems.
Eager to learn, growth-oriented, and highly accountable.
Positive mindset, clear goals, and strong focus on outcomes.
Willing to embrace new challenges and perform effectively under pressure.
Strong understanding of Customer Service operations, systems and passenger transportation.
Strong team management and leadership skills
Proven ability to train, coach, and develop team members.
Strong data analysis and reporting skills.
Proficient in Microsoft Office and workplace productivity tools.
